description:
We’re Growing Our Team! – Salesforce Developer (Mid-Level), 

(remote – only from Romania and R. of Moldova having a work permit in Romania)


We’re looking to expand our passionate and professional Salesforce team with an experienced, hands-on Salesforce Developer who loves to build smart, scalable, and impactful solutions. 

If you enjoy solving real-world challenges and continuously improving your technical skills, we want to hear from you!

Company Description

Recognos Romania is part of the Recognos group, which specializes in developing innovative systems and products for the financial industry. With a strong focus on emerging semantic technologies, the company has successfully implemented solutions highlighting the transformative potential of this technology. Established in 2000, Recognos Romania collaborates globally with offices in Silicon Valley, ensuring efficient teamwork across borders. At Recognos, innovation, enthusiasm, and fostering quality of life for team members are at the forefront of our mission, creating value-oriented products and solutions.

Required Knowledge, Competencies & Experience

• 2–3+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer (preferably in mid-to-large projects)

• Proven experience with custom development, including:

• Creating and maintaining Custom Objects, Fields, Page Layouts, Validation Rules, Record Types, Relationships, and Dynamic Forms

• Designing and implementing Apex Classes, Triggers, Batch Apex, and Queueable Jobs

• Building Lightning Web Components (LWC) with clean, modular JavaScript and HTML

• Working with Flows and Platform Events for automation and integration

• Writing efficient SOQL/SOSL queries, and understanding governor limits

• Experience in data modeling – ability to design relational data structures optimized for both flexibility and performance

• Hands-on experience with Agentforce (AI + Automation layer of Salesforce) is a strong plus

• Solid understanding of Salesforce security model, FLS, and sharing rules

• Strong grasp of object-oriented programming and software design patterns

• Familiar with Salesforce best practices and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Nice to Have

• Experience with source control systems (Git, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps)

• Knowledge of integration patterns and APIs (REST, SOAP)

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools and Salesforce DX

• Exposure to .NET, C#, or KingswaySoft SSIS toolkit is a plus

• Experience with Relational and NoSQL databases

Soft Skills & Work Style

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset — “make it happen” attitude

• Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

• Team player who collaborates well in an agile, fast-paced environment

• Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to work independently

• Client-oriented with a proactive approach to knowledge sharing and mentoring

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions aligned with business requirements

• Customize and extend Salesforce using Apex, LWC, Flows, and declarative tools

• Integrate Salesforce with internal and external systems via APIs or middleware

• Participate in data migration and transformation activities

• Conduct unit tests, peer code reviews, and documentation

• Ensure data integrity, system reliability, and adherence to security standards

• Support testing and deployment cycles (UAT, production releases)

• Contribute to continuous improvement and internal development standards

• Optionally, coach and support junior team members

Reasons to Join Us and What we Offer

• Competitive compensation

• Remote work (work from home) with flexible schedule

• Private medical insurance

• Meal tickets

• Financial support for remote work

• A stable and dynamic work environment where you can develop professionally

• Professional growth opportunities via training, knowledge-sharing and coaching sessions

• The opportunity to become part of an excellent and dynamic team

If there’s a match between your skills, your experiences, your wants and what we require and what we offer, do not hesitate to send your CV at .
